title: Professor Layton and the Curious Village
subtitle: An inheritance hidden in riddles
summary: Professor Layton and the Curious Village is Level-5's Nintendo DS puzzle adventure introducing Professor Hershel Layton and his young assistant Luke. They visit St. Mystere to investigate the Golden Apple, an heirloom connected to the late baron's fortune. body: Professor Layton and the Curious Village is Level-5's Nintendo DS puzzle adventure introducing Professor Hershel Layton and his young assistant Luke. They visit St. Mystere to investigate the Golden Apple, an heirloom connected to the late baron's fortune. The village's residents share a remarkable fondness for puzzles, making a conversation as likely to produce a brainteaser as a clue. Animated sequences and an illustrated setting connect these individual challenges into a mystery. Solving one question becomes a way of earning another piece of the village's attention.

The player taps people and objects to investigate the village. A puzzle may call for a number, a marked area, a sequence of movements or another form of touchscreen response. Its value is measured in picarats, while hint coins can purchase progressively more helpful clues. Time is available for thought; committing to an incorrect answer can reduce the reward. The different inputs let a collection of traditional brainteasers feel comfortable on the DS, with the stylus serving as both an investigating finger and a pencil.

Hidden puzzles and hint coins reward attention to the illustrations, giving an apparently decorative corner a possible use. Unsolved puzzles that become inaccessible can reappear at Granny Riddleton's shack, keeping the larger collection approachable as the story advances. Rewards also supply pieces for small activities in Layton's trunk, including a robotic dog and arrangements for the visitors' rooms. These details make the village feel hospitable to curiosity. The central mystery provides direction, but the small pleasure of noticing something gives the player a reason to linger.
story_headings: The answer is under the stylus
